name: Strategy
summary: The world as a board: its businesses are holdings that yield by trade per hand per turn, its settlements the territory a strict majority controls, its residents the hands; the player takes holdings, puts people to work and feeds them, turn by turn, against keepers who hold and wait.

parameters.doc: coin a holding costs when the world's strategy section names no default price (10)
food one worker eats a turn when the section names no upkeep (1)
coin in the player's starting purse when the section names none (25)
food in the player's starting purse when the section names none (6)
hands one holding takes besides its holder when the section names none (2)

extensionPoints.signature: WorldIR.strategy {resources?, outputs?, claimCosts?, workerUpkeep?, workersPerHolding?, startingStock?, playerFaction?}
extensionPoints.doc: a world's own table over core's (src/strategy/strategy.ts): authored rows win, table for table
each remaining worker turning up at their holding at the end of a turn
read with readStrategyBlock (src/strategy/strategy-save.ts), restored with StrategyDirector.restore over the same world's campaign

assistant.summary: src/strategy/strategy.ts builds the campaign (campaignForWorld: holdings, yields, prices, upkeep, the board and its neighbours from the world and its strategy section); StrategyDirector (src/game-engine/logic/StrategyDirector.ts) remembers holders, stockpiles, workers and the turn and asks the KB every question; src/strategy/strategy-save.ts is the extensions.strategy block. The engine draws the board, the resource bar and the turn button.
notes: Only the player's faction acts: the keepers hold, earn and wait. There is no opponent AI in this pack.
End a turn with endTurn(): a faction that cannot feed its workers sends them home (canonically last first) before the turn's net is added, and every remaining worker is told to work.
A strict majority of a settlement's trading businesses is control; control of every settlement that trades is victory.
City-building uses this module (U87(6)); player construction and base building (catalog construction-building-placement) is port-later and not part of this pack.
doNot: Change a stockpile or a holder outside the director: the KB and the director must say the same.
Store a turn's net, control or victory in a save: they are derived from the board.
